order: For pair i, rotate arms left by i modulo 4. Complete all four arms before next pair.
freeze_rules: Gate excluded from efficacy analysis; behavior and metric definitions frozen before first case.
Use original preset horizon and validator. Keep failure, timeout and missing evidence in denominator.
No outcome-based seed/task/threshold changes. Code or prompt changes require a new version and manifest.
Two seeds per task are exploratory repetitions, not a powered or held-out benchmark.
Projector-off intervenes on evidence injection with the same topology policy; realized closed-loop topologies need not match.
No stage contracts/semantic guards/manual task decomposition in any arm. No claim of subtask VMCR without metadata.
